accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:exact-covariance-saddle and thm:finite-sample-robust-inference
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The exact saddle, least-favourable schedule, and coverage claims are restricted to the declared aggregate-coefficient ellipsoid, a strict subclass of the broader low-order schedule class.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Exact covariance minimaxity and finite-sample coverage hold UNDER C_{n,beta}(B,omega); no claim transfers them to the unrestricted CortezEichhornYu2022 coefficient class.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 3-5, Assumption 2 and Section 3.1, especially Theorems 2-3 on p. 5
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper specifies low-degree polynomial potential outcomes, implements monotone Bernoulli rollout by one U_i~Unif[0,1] thresholded at every p_t, and proves unbiased polynomial-interpolation estimators with spacing-based variance bounds.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 5, 'The Optimality of Restricted Randomization: The Mixed-Strategy Optimal Design'
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: For M_K={Ku:u^T K u<=C}, the paper gives worst-case variance C lambda_max(K^{1/2}Q(sigma)K^{1/2}) and frames the mixed-strategy optimal design as minimizing that largest eigenvalue.
The paper bounds the variance of a standard HT estimator under one-hop interference and then optimizes an MSE upper bound using the assignment covariance matrix as the design variable.

source_verification_receipts.locator: article abstract and publication record, pp. 136-151
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article studies design-based causal inference under arbitrary and network interference and documents the finite-population randomization setting's limitations without structural restrictions.
The paper studies low-order outcome models under general and clustered designs, provides a pseudoinverse estimator with bias-variance bounds, and uses those bounds for clustering choice.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add an explicit scaling bridge from realistic local-interference coefficient patterns to the B^2/n aggregate ellipsoid, including how B and omega are elicited or conservatively calibrated.

State the block multiplicities, a concrete normalized construction of Q, and an algorithmic complexity bound for evaluating every H_h; this makes the claimed design computability independently auditable.

Promote the analytic frontier by proving an explicit nontrivial Chebyshev-optimal and Chebyshev-suboptimal parameter region with a global dual certificate, rather than leaving all node-optimality content in the OEQ.

recommended_next_step: Advance to Stage 0 on the field-tier exact-saddle kernel, retaining the aggregate-ellipsoid restriction explicitly in every headline claim.
